prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 39 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1007; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment grew to many times the usual amount for this injury, with near-daily visits and new body areas added weeks after the crash.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Treating Provider Clinical Summary

The patient presented after a sideswipe collision during a lane change and reports neck and back strain. The reported mechanism is consistent with the injuries described. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm soft tissue injury to the cervical and lumbar regions. No earlier injury to these areas is known. Care has included 39 visits, with near-daily sessions for much of the course. Additional body regions were added several weeks after the collision, and the volume of treatment is well above what is typical for a strain of this kind. Billing records show no repeated charges for the same services. The plan going forward is active rehabilitation with scheduled reassessment and a review of discharge criteria once functional goals are met.
